name: unsafe fn from_raw_parts (ptr : * mut T , length : usize , capacity : usize) -> Self
rule: For safety, the first `length` values pointed to by `ptr` must be properly initialized values of type `T`.
api: impl < T > alloc::vec::Vec < T > { unsafe fn from_raw_parts (ptr : * mut T , length : usize , capacity : usize) -> Self }
expression: The requirement is not expressible in the supplied grammar: `ptr.$mem.pointee.valid` covers only one `T`, and no supported operation observes typed validity for each of the first `length` elements.
